evidence_span.text: Knockdown of cep290 function in sentinel fish results in a synergistic pronephric cyst phenotype, revealing a genetic interaction between CC2D2A and CEP290 and implicating CC2D2A in cilium/basal body function.

reviews.rationale: Human loss-of-function mutations plus zebrafish knockdown and CEP290 genetic interaction causally implicate CC2D2A in ciliary/basal-body function, supporting its ciliopathy-gene role for cilium assembly. Evidence from human patients and zebrafish kidney is indirect to mouse brain endothelial cilia, so the declared partial context is overclaimed.
